project.name: Lumen: AI Support Assistant
project.description: Lumen is a 12-person startup shipping **Lumen Assist**, an AI assistant that answers customer-support tickets from the help center and hands off to humans when unsure. Goal: beta with 20 customers by 2 Oct, public launch 16 Oct.

docs.title: Beta brief: Lumen Assist v1
docs.body:
# Beta brief

**Problem:** support teams answer the same questions all day; first replies take hours.

**Beta scope:** answer tickets from the help center with **cited sources**, hand off to a human when confidence is low, live chat widget.

## Success metrics
- ≥ 70% of beta tickets answered without a human
- answer accuracy ≥ 90% on the eval set
- p95 answer time < 3 s
- 20 beta customers by 2 Oct
docs.author: layla

docs.title: Support tone guide
docs.body:
# Tone

Friendly, short, specific. Always cite the help-center article. Never guess: if unsure, say so and hand off to a human.
docs.author: tom

docs.title: Eval rubric
docs.body:
# Eval rubric

Each answer is graded on: **correct** (matches the article), **cited** (links the right source), **safe** (no invented policy). A ticket passes only if all three hold.
docs.author: sara

docs.title: ADR: retrieval stack
docs.body:
# ADR-001: retrieval stack

- Embeddings + hybrid search (BM25 + vectors) over the help center
- Answers must cite ≥ 1 source chunk
- Confidence < 0.6 → hand off to a human
docs.author: sara

docs.title: Runway & budget
docs.body:
# Runway (confidential)

- Cash: €1.4m, runway 16 months
- AI spend cap for the beta: €2,500 / month
docs.author: layla

tasks.title: Define beta scope & success metrics
tasks.description: Agree what Lumen Assist v1 must do for the beta and how we measure it.
tasks.scope: In: scope, metrics, beta customer profile. Out: pricing.

tasks.title: Choose the retrieval architecture
tasks.description: Decide how answers are retrieved and cited. Recorded as ADR-001.
tasks.scope: In: search approach, citation rule, hand-off threshold.

tasks.title: Interview 12 support leads
tasks.description: Find the biggest support pain points to shape the beta.
tasks.scope: In: 12 interviews, synthesis. Out: pricing questions.

tasks.title: Beta waitlist landing page
tasks.description: Waitlist page for beta customers, built on the interview insights from T-3.

tasks.title: Build the help-center ingestion pipeline
tasks.description: Import all help-center articles, split them into chunks and index them for hybrid search, as decided in T-2.
tasks.scope: In: import, chunking, embeddings, index. Out: answering (T-9).

tasks.title: Ticket API & authentication
tasks.description: REST API that receives support tickets from customers' helpdesks and returns answers.
tasks.scope: In: endpoints, API keys, rate limits. Out: hand-off (T-10).

tasks.title: Chat widget UI
tasks.description: Embeddable chat widget customers add to their site; follows the tone guide.
tasks.scope: In: widget UI, theming, mobile. Out: live answers (T-11).

tasks.title: CI pipeline & staging environment
tasks.description: Automated tests on every push and a staging environment for the beta.
tasks.scope: In: CI, staging deploy, secrets. Out: load testing (T-13).

tasks.title: Answer engine with cited sources
tasks.description: Generate answers from the indexed help center (T-5) with at least one cited source; low confidence hands off (T-10).
tasks.scope: In: retrieval, answer generation, citations, confidence score.

tasks.title: Human hand-off for low-confidence tickets
tasks.description: When the answer engine is unsure, route the ticket to a human agent with context, using the ticket API (T-6).
tasks.scope: In: routing, context summary, helpdesk integration.

tasks.title: Connect the widget to live answers
tasks.description: Stream answers from the ticket API (T-6) into the chat widget (T-7), with sources shown under each answer.
tasks.scope: In: streaming, source cards, error states.

tasks.title: Evaluation harness on 200 real tickets
tasks.description: Automatically grade answers against the eval rubric on 200 anonymised tickets, in CI (T-8).
tasks.scope: In: test set, grading, CI report.

tasks.title: Beta readiness: load test & go/no-go report
tasks.description: Load-test the full system and write the go/no-go report for the beta.
tasks.scope: In: load test, eval results, risks, recommendation.

tasks.title: Tune answers from eval results
tasks.description: Use the eval harness (T-12) to improve the answer engine (T-9) before the beta.
tasks.scope: In: prompt and retrieval tuning. Out: new features.

tasks.title: Launch campaign
tasks.description: Announce the public launch to the waitlist from T-4 and the press.

tasks.title: Pricing page & plans
tasks.description: Plans and pricing for the public launch, based on the interviews (T-3).
tasks.scope: In: plans, page copy. Out: billing integration.

tasks.title: Security review before launch
tasks.description: Review data handling, API keys and prompt-injection risks before the public launch.

history.summary: Scoped the beta with a **research agent** (competitor teardown of 6 support AIs) and a **writer agent** (beta brief K-1). Key call: every answer must cite its source.
Compared 3 retrieval stacks with a **research agent**; a **prototype agent** built a spike on 300 articles. Hybrid search won on accuracy (+11 pts). Recorded as ADR-001.

12 interviews transcribed and clustered by a **research agent**; a **synthesis agent** ranked the pain points.

![Top pain points](/api/artifacts/b7c1d2e3f4a50617)

Repeat questions are the #1 pain (67%). This shaped the beta brief (T-1) and the waitlist page (T-4).
A **copywriting agent** wrote 3 headline variants from the interview quotes (T-3); the winner converts at 6.8%. 214 teams on the waitlist.
A **research agent** compared pricing of 8 support-AI tools; drafting 3 plans (Starter / Team / Scale).
